units.content: Models intelligence as an observer-reality feedback system that both represents and changes the world.

Proposes coupled state (O,X), representation as intervention, observer transformation, finite observation/resolution boundaries and truth alignment as coupling quality rather than static internal consistency.
Uses X_t -> O_t -> Action_t -> X_(t+1), R(X)->A->X', Delta R -> Delta P^reach -> action -> Delta P^actual, and Future=f(Reality,Representation,Action,Feedback).
Observer-reality theory; no measured observer-boundary or truth-coupling result is reported.
Models intelligence as movement through spaces of representations, uncertainty and possible transformations.

Proposes that representation shifts can change problem geometry, compression can reduce dimensionality, invariants provide stable coordinates, and advanced intelligence can reshape the landscape rather than only navigate it.
Newtonian/relativistic representations, calculus, Fourier analysis, machine-learning latent spaces, mathematics/programming/scientific theories illustrate geometry changes.
Information-geometry theory/analogy; no measured manifold/metric or validated geodesic model is reported.
Models learning about the process of learning itself.
Distinguishes facts, patterns, strategies and learning-to-discover; introduces learning generator G_L, curriculum strategy pi_L, error gradients and optimization of optimization.
Uses Delta G_L>0, error-to-update dynamics, intelligence gradient improvement, learning velocity v_L and dv_L/dt as recursive-learning quantities.
Meta-learning theory; no autonomous meta-learning trajectory is reported.
Integrates representation, compression, generation, evaluation, recursion, alignment, causal mass, geometry and civilization into a source-described unified conceptual theory.

Proposes recursive intelligence as reality-coupled transformation in which representations/invariants/compression enable generation/action, feedback improves generators and expanded reachability is a downstream output.
Conceptual RI=f(R,K,G,F,Delta G_m,A,B); reachability principle Delta P^reach; singularity boundary dG_m/dt>0; causal mass and geometry submodels.
The source says the framework is complete as a conceptual theory after 60 layers; this is source self-characterization, not scientific validation or supersession authority.
CONCEPTUAL_THEORY_COMPLETE != EMPIRICALLY_ESTABLISHED != PRIOR_LAYER_SUPERSEDED.
Translates the recursive-intelligence framework into a proposed dynamical system of states/operators/transitions.
Proposes S_(t+1)=F(S_t,E_t) with component updates for representation, generator, reachable space, alignment and boundary; recursive condition dG/dt>0 and d^2C/dt^2>0.
Proposes I(I_system)=f(Delta R,Delta K,Delta G,Delta P,A_T,Phi) as a compressed intelligence objective/characterization.
Formal mathematical specification/proposal; equations are not fitted, proved or empirically validated on this source.
Designs an empirical program intended to test generator improvement, reachability expansion, truth coupling, causal mass and alignment in real systems.
Proposed measured state S_t=(R_t,G_t,P_t,A_t,Phi_t,A_T,t) with source-local representation/generator/reachability/alignment/causal-mass/truth-coupling meanings.

Proposes representation interventions, adaptive-vs-fixed generator tests, reachability tasks, truth-coupling loops, hallucination correction, causal-mass ablations, scaling controls, component ablations, longitudinal tracking, multi-domain transfer, interface tests and civilization-scale tests.

Framework weakened by acceleration without generator change, generator change without reachability expansion, representation change without prediction/transfer, unmeasurable truth coupling, or alignment unrelated to trajectory stability.
Empirical validation program only; no real-system measurements or validation outcomes appear.
Designs a computational architecture capable of recursive improvement, representation discovery, truth coupling and controlled reachability expansion.
Proposes observation, representation/world-model, search, action, evaluation, improvement-generator, truth-coupling, alignment, memory/improvement archive and controlled self-modification components.
Source recursive-depth hierarchy runs from fixed algorithm through solution/strategy/representation learning to learning representation discovery and improving learning itself.
AGI-like behavior is proposed when Delta G_m>0 and Delta P^reach>0 occur without external redesign at every step.
Computational architecture proposal; current R09 source contains Markdown only and no implementation/execution artifact.
Designs stability mechanisms for systems that could modify their own improvement processes.

Proposes capability/evaluation/control layers, reality verification, alignment invariants, improvement gates, self-modification firewall, rollback, diversity, adversarial evaluation, interpretability and distributed control.
Safe recursion is proposed to require Delta G_m>0 with nondecreasing stability/truth coupling/alignment and control velocity at least matching capability velocity.
Capability drift, representation drift, objective drift, evaluation collapse and control loss are proposed failure modes.
Safety/control specification; no safety proof or executed adversarial evaluation is reported.
Extends economic production models with recursively improvable intelligence/generator capacity.

Proposes Y=f(K,L,R,G_m), cognitive capital K_I, cognitive arbitrage, a generator economy, representation economy, causal-mass value, evaluation/problem-selection bottlenecks and recursively improving production functions.
Software, algorithms, scientific methods, AI, automated workflows, markets and augmented labor are interpretive economic examples.
Economic extension/theory; no economic estimate or causal result is reported.
Models a civilization transitioning from using intelligence to systematically improving intelligence production.

Defines civilization state/generator, institutions as algorithms, science as a recursive truth process, AI-assisted generator acceleration, bottleneck migration, coordination/alignment and causal mass.
Proposes a civilization transition signature Delta G_c>0 -> Delta P^reach_c>0 -> d^2C_c/dt^2>0 while preserving alignment/truth coupling.
Civilization-transition theory; no civilization-scale transition is reported as observed.
Generalizes variation-selection-retention/reachability dynamics across evolution, learning, science, AI and civilization.
This layer defines Omega as total possibility space and S_t as a subset explored/reachable within it. This is semantically distinct from earlier Omega velocity/acceleration definitions.
Proposes evolution as search with reality as selection, useful-transformation retention, representation-guided search and recursive improvement of the evolutionary generator.
Defines G_e candidate generator, v_E=Delta P^reach/Delta t, acceleration dv_E/dt>0 and conceptual reachability/evolution equations.
Universal evolutionary dynamics theory; use of Omega and universal language creates no semantic identity with other layers by token match.
Models intelligence as a distributed field of transformation potential across systems, environments and representations.
Defines intelligence density, potential, flow, source/sink regions, coupling, gradients, causal-mass density, alignment direction, field amplification and civilization as a propagation medium.
Conceptual I(x,t)=f(R,G_m,P^reach,A,Phi,C_I) and vector/gradient relations are proposed as a field model.
Frozen file reaches a Final Architecture fenced text block and terminates after 'Field Update ↺' without visible closing continuation.
No text after the terminal Final Architecture fragment is present on the frozen blob; any missing closure/final principle/summary is unknown rather than inferred.
Attempts to compress the framework into a final source-described unified equation.

Defines S=(R,G_m,P,A,Phi,B), transformation operator T, I proportional to Delta P^reach/Delta t, Delta P^reach=f(Delta R,Delta K,Delta G_m,A,B,F), recursive conditions and I=(Delta P^reach*A*Phi)/Delta t.
Interprets intelligence as recursive aligned transformation of reachable futures and causal persistence; source uses final/unified language.

After the Complete Intelligence Loop the frozen Markdown contains an unclosed text block and mangled equations/spacing; major semantic content remains recoverable but formatting is not silently normalized as original source.
'Final Unified Equation' is source self-description, not proof, empirical validation or supersession authority.
Designs experiments intended to distinguish reachability-transformation theory from ordinary task-performance models.

Proposes recursive-improvement, representation-discovery, reachability-expansion, generator-ablation, compression-growth, alignment-preservation, human-AI coevolution and civilization-scale tests plus benchmark redesign/meta-benchmarking.
Predicts recursive systems should show Delta G_m>0, acceleration of P^reach, capability and causal mass while preserving alignment; fixed/scaling alternatives should differ.
Frozen source contains an unclosed text-block style region and mangled spacing after Final Experimental Architecture; experiment semantics remain substantially recoverable.
Empirical test framework/protocol; no experiment has been executed or reported on the frozen R09 surface.
Translates recursive-reachability theory into a proposed implementable system architecture.

Six-module candidate architecture: representation, search, improvement generator, evaluation, alignment, memory; also bottleneck detector, architecture-of-architectures recursion, interfaces, sandbox prototype and objective J=Delta P^reach*A*Phi under resource bounds.

Proposes recursive systems should improve the transformation pipeline, eventually showing accelerating capability when G_m itself improves; reliable self-evaluation is proposed as a likely bottleneck.
Frozen source enters an unclosed text block after Recursive Improvement Loop and later equations/text are mangled in formatting but semantically recoverable.
Engineering architecture/prototype design; no running prototype is present in R09.
Designs an operating layer for managing intelligence as an evolving process rather than a fixed model.

Proposes OS_I=(M,R,P,E,A,U), cognitive memory/representation management, process/improvement scheduling, evaluation/alignment kernels, sandboxing, intelligence API primitives, recursive debugging, resource allocation and distributed/civilization-scale coordination.

The intelligence OS is described as an environment controlling evolution of cognitive processes; multiple representations, sandboxed updates and alignment checks are proposed as stability requirements.
Frozen source begins an unclosed code block in the Traditional vs Recursive OS section and subsequent text/equations are formatting-mangled but substantially readable.
Operating-system architecture proposal; no executable OS implementation or API exists on the frozen source tree.
Models a reality-coupling threshold preventing increasingly powerful internal representations from drifting away from external feedback.

Defines C_R reality coupling, closed reality loops, truth alignment as maintained correspondence, error correction, hallucination as insufficient coupling, reality pressure as selection and expansion-with-grounding as the desired regime.
Uses D(M,X), coupling metric Gamma_R, Delta G_m -> Delta G_truth, Delta P^reach with Delta C_R, and conceptual I_T=f(R,G_m,P^reach,A,C_R).
Reality-coupling theory; no measured threshold or Gamma_R trajectory is reported.
Models intelligence as navigation, reshaping and expansion of possible/reachable system states.

Distinguishes possible vs reachable phase space, representation as coordinate transformation, navigation efficiency, search landscape geometry, navigation generator G_N, exploration/exploitation and topological compression.

Uses Omega as state/phase space, Omega_possible/Omega_reachable, eta_N useful-states/search-cost, Delta G_N>0, Phi proportional to Delta Omega_reachable and I_N=f(R,Compression,Prediction,Search,G_N,Alignment).
Phase-space-navigation theory; the current repository path is Layer 74 while the source text self-identifies as Layer 73. Neither naming choice creates scientific standing or supersession.
